fleet_mix.label: Fleet Mix
fleet_mix.desc: Similarity based on the distribution of vessel types visiting the port.

operations.label: Operations
operations.desc: Focus on stay patterns, handling efficiency, and vessel loyalty.

scale.label: Vessel Scale
scale.desc: Similarity in the physical dimensions (size and depth) of visiting vessels.

infrastructure.label: Infrastructure
infrastructure.desc: Comparison based on WPI physical characteristics and capacity.

temporal.label: Temporal Patterns

connectivity.label: Connectivity
connectivity.desc: Similarity based on trade network flow diversity, domestic ratio, and vessel throughput.

featureDocs.pct_hsc:
Source: port_visits table (`ship_type`).
Calc: (High Speed Craft visits / Total Visits) * 100.
featureDocs.median_stay_h:
Source: port_visits table (`stay_duration_hours`).
Calc: Median duration (hours) between first and last AIS ping within the port polygon for a continuous visit.
featureDocs.stay_iqr_h:
Source: port_visits table (`stay_duration_hours`).
Calc: Interquartile range (75th - 25th percentile) of stay durations. Indicates variability.
featureDocs.pct_short_stay:
Source: port_visits table (`stay_duration_hours`).
Calc: Percentage of visits lasting < 4 hours.
featureDocs.pct_long_stay:
Source: port_visits table (`stay_duration_hours`).
Calc: Percentage of visits lasting > 48 hours.
featureDocs.mean_length_m:
Source: port_visits table (`length_m`).
Calc: Average length of unique visiting vessels.
featureDocs.median_length_m:
Source: port_visits table (`length_m`).
Calc: Median length of unique visiting vessels.
featureDocs.mean_draught_m:
Source: port_visits table (`draught_m`).
Calc: Average reported draught of visiting vessels.
featureDocs.median_draught_m:
Source: port_visits table (`draught_m`).
Calc: Median reported draught of visiting vessels.
featureDocs.harbor_size_int:
Source: ports table (`harbor_size`).
Calc: Encoded categorical size (1: Very Small, 4: Large).
featureDocs.shelter_afforded_int:
Source: shelter_afforded column.
Calc: Encoded shelter quality (1: Poor, 4: Excellent).
featureDocs.channel_depth_m:
Source: ports table (`channel_depth_m`).
Calc: Max depth (m) in main entrance channel.
featureDocs.anchorage_depth_m:
Source: ports table (`anchorage_depth_m`).
Calc: Depth (m) of the primary anchorage area.
featureDocs.cargo_pier_depth_m:
Source: ports table (`cargo_pier_depth_m`).
Calc: Max depth (m) at cargo piers.
featureDocs.night_visit_ratio:
Source: port_visits table (`arrival_time`).
Calc: Percentage of visits arriving between 22:00 and 06:00.
featureDocs.weekend_visit_ratio:
Source: port_visits table (`arrival_time`).
Calc: Percentage of visits arriving on Saturday or Sunday.
featureDocs.peak_hour_entropy:
Source: port_visits table (`arrival_time`).
Calc: Shannon entropy of arrival hours (0-23). Higher values indicate a more uniform distribution of arrivals throughout the day.
featureDocs.seasonal_cv:
Source: port_visits table (`arrival_time`).
Calc: Coefficient of variation (standard deviation / mean) of monthly visit counts. Measures seasonality.
featureDocs.destination_diversity:
Source: port_visits table (`declared_destination`).
Calc: Shannon entropy of declared destination port strings. Measures the diversity of connected routes.
featureDocs.intra_country_ratio:
Source: port_visits table (`declared_destination`).
Calc: Percentage of voyages where the destination is within the same country. Measures domestic vs. international focus.
featureDocs.total_visits:
Source: port_visits table.
Calc: Total number of recorded vessel visits.
featureDocs.unique_vessels:
Source: port_visits table (`mmsi`).
Calc: Total number of unique vessels visiting the port.
featureDocs.visits_per_week:
Source: port_visits table.
Calc: Average number of visits per week.
